idle.action: Stationary two-legged mechanical combat mech with body-mounted cannon always pointing south/down. Feet planted, only subtle piston compression and small torso settling; stable amber sensor. Preserve camera and exact armor layout. No arms or humanoid gestures.

walk.action: One full mechanical biped walk cycle in place with cannon always pointing south/down. Frame 1 left foot advanced and right foot back; frame 2 feet passing and left leg compressing; frame 3 right foot advanced and left foot back; frame 4 opposite passing pose. Both feet must stay distinct and attached; short controlled steps; torso and cannon stabilize around the same hip pivot. No arms, no tracks, no camera changes.

attack.action: One body-mounted cannon shot, pointing south/down throughout: frame 1 neutral braced stance, frame 2 small hard-edged amber muzzle flash physically attached to cannon muzzle and barrel recoils slightly, frame 3 no flash and barrel slides forward, frame 4 exact neutral recovery. Feet planted, same two legs; no arms or handheld weapon. All recoil and flash remain inside the frame.
